chapters: Marion and Lark were the same person. Marion wore a grey coat. Lark smiled.
Elias Vale and Marion Vale were different people. Vale was their shared family name.
Captain Asha carried a brass compass. Captain Rowan carried a silver cup. The captain waited.
Corin Myles entered. Myles wore a green coat.
